entries.notes: Process stability/health snapshot backed by the Go runtime (goroutines/cpu/memstats/GC), the boot crash/restart recovery outcomes (recoveryStatusSnapshot), and the agent-job registry (in-flight runs) + restart-scheduler readiness.

Reads/lists the durable, structured dream-diary store (dated {phase, candidates-considered, promoted-record-ids, counts, narrative} entries) persisted per consolidation cycle and mirrored NIP-44 encrypted through the memory outbox. swarmstr-qc53.1/.4.

Replays consolidation over existing memories (promotion tier), bucketing activity by UTC day, to synthesize retroactive dated diary entries for the trailing 30 days. Idempotent via a partial unique index on synthetic (scope,date,phase). swarmstr-qc53.4.

Clears the diary store for a scope. Per-scope + confirmation-token gated (tokenless call previews the required token; mismatch rejected). Runs under the store maintenance lock. Does not touch underlying memory records. swarmstr-qc53.4.

Demotes/unpromotes the grounded-short-term buffer (recency-bounded, source-cited view over the promotion tier) by clearing promotion markers — reversible, never deletes. Per-scope + confirmation-token gated. swarmstr-qc53.3/.4.
Repairs consolidated-record integrity via memory.RepairMemoryHealth (supersession/index/dedupe). swarmstr's 'dreaming artifacts' are the promoted/consolidated memory records.
No persisted dream-diary artifact in swarmstr; dedupes the analogous consolidated/promoted memory records via CompactMemoryRecords.
Exercises the real REM dreaming/consolidation phase (RunDreamingPhases/PromotionManager) as a non-committing dry run by default; apply=true promotes.
Starts the resolved configured extension account using its real lifecycle handle.
Stops the resolved configured extension account and closes its real lifecycle handle.
Lists personas from cfg.Extra[talk].personas; active persona persisted via the ops registry.
Validates against configured persona ids; off/none/default clear the active persona to null.
Returns schema for a specific config path; full schema when path is empty.
Returns one live, unexpired exec approval with reviewer-safe display fields.
Returns the authoritative live pending exec approvals in deterministic FIFO order.
Durable plugin-approval ledger (internal/gateway/pluginapproval), modeled on question.* / exec.approval.*.
Poses a pending approval into the durable plugin-approval ledger.
Pose-and-block on the operator decision, mirroring question.waitAnswer / exec.approval.waitDecision.
Records an operator approve/deny decision and wakes waiters.
Aggregates the plugin UI-surface registry's board-widget descriptors (SDK manifest v4 Surfaces block) across all loaded plugins; metiq-native shape. OperatorRead. Delivered by swarmstr-qmxu.

Dispatches a plugin-declared session-action verb into the owning plugin's sandboxed runtime (may mutate session). Gated by a board.widget.grant view ticket + OperatorAdmin; fail-closed for untrusted plugins. Delivered by swarmstr-qmxu.

Compat alias (swarmstr-i413). OpenClaw's Control-UI chat send; thin alias that re-dispatches to the native chat.send DM transport and returns its shape. Triage stays accepted-deviation (prefix-locked) but the data-plane functionality is genuinely implemented.
Compat alias (swarmstr-i413). OpenClaw's Control-UI transcript history; thin alias that re-dispatches to the native chat.history docs/transcript surface and returns its shape.

Compat alias (swarmstr-i413). OpenClaw's Control-UI changes/review surface; thin alias that re-dispatches to the native sessions.files.list surface, which lists the session's touched/changed workspace files (transcript-derived). Metiq surfaces changed file state rather than a git per-hunk diff.
Compat alias (swarmstr-i413). OpenClaw's Control-UI approval queue; thin alias that re-dispatches to the native approval.list durable-ledger surface and returns its shape.

Honest UNAVAILABLE (accepted deviation, stays missing). Detects an OpenClaw application install; there is nothing to detect for a nostr-key-native daemon that is not OpenClaw. Left unregistered rather than faking a stub. Product follow-up: swarmstr-nuqy.

Honest UNAVAILABLE (accepted deviation, stays missing). Activates an OpenClaw install/license; not meaningful for a nostr daemon whose identity is a nostr keypair. Left unregistered. Product follow-up: swarmstr-nuqy.

Honest UNAVAILABLE (accepted deviation, stays missing). Starts OpenClaw's onboarding auth flow; Metiq identity is nostr-key-based and has no OpenClaw auth handshake. Left unregistered. Product follow-up: swarmstr-nuqy.

Honest UNAVAILABLE (accepted deviation, stays missing). Prepares an OpenClaw environment during onboarding; no equivalent OpenClaw environment exists to prepare. Left unregistered. Product follow-up: swarmstr-nuqy.
Speech section backed by the live tts manager; transcription/realtime sections honestly report ready:false while the realtimestt/realtimevoice registries are unwired.
Client-owned session record store; browser-owned realtime transports require a realtimevoice provider with createBrowserSession support and return UNAVAILABLE until one is wired.
Appends transcript entries to the client session record.
Closes a client-origin session record.
Bridges the realtime agent-consult tool into a managed agent run (agent runtime dispatch + run id).
Steers the client session's active browser-owned run via the steering mailbox.

Connection-owned gateway-relay session + turn state machine; audio transport binds to the realtimevoice/realtimestt registries and returns UNAVAILABLE until an audio provider is wired. managed-room transport is an accepted deviation (no LiveKit infra).
managed-room only; accepted deviation — returns unsupported (no LiveKit room infra in metiq).
Forwards decoded audio to the bound realtime provider; UNAVAILABLE until a realtime provider is wired.
Explicit-commit relay turn boundary (relay substitute for the managed-room turn protocol).
Commits an open relay turn into processing (relay substitute for the managed-room turn protocol).
Interrupts the in-flight turn via the provider bridge and returns the session to idle.
Interrupts model audio output via the provider bridge.
Gateway-side playback-mark bookkeeping.
Forwards a realtime tool-call result to the voice bridge; UNAVAILABLE/unsupported without a realtime bridge.
Enqueues steering text into the session steering mailbox.
Tears down the session and its provider transport; emits talk.session.closed.
Synthesizes via the live tts manager with talk-config provider/voice-alias + persona overrides; structured error reasons (talk_unconfigured/synthesis_failed/invalid_audio_result).
Operator/slash command registry backed by the embedded Web UI command catalog (internal/webui) — the same surface advertised to clients via /command-catalog.json.

Per-provider credential/auth status over the provider layer (state.ProvidersConfig + env credentials + internal/agent OAuth adapters). Reports configured/enabled + auth method (api_key | oauth | none); no secret material is returned.
Clears a provider's config-stored credentials via a runtime config mutation. Env-var credentials cannot be cleared from a running process and are reported as remaining.

Effective tool set for an agent: the tool catalog filtered by the agent's active profile (agent.FilterCatalogByProfile), overlaid — when the WS-G permission engine is configured — with each tool's engine decision behavior.
Operator-driven single-tool invocation through the live agent.ToolRegistry.Execute path (schema + semantic validation, tool policy, pre/post hooks). OperatorAdmin because it executes.

Resolves a minted MCP-App view: html (inline or lazily fetched via resources/read), toolInput/toolResult, expiry; views minted from agent MCP tool calls returning ui:// resources, announced via mcp.app.viewCreated.
Lists tools advertised by the view's originating server.
Proxies resources/list to the view's originating server.
Proxies resources/templates/list to the view's originating server.
Proxies resources/read to the view's originating server.
Calls a tool on the view's originating server; denied for read-only views. Metiq deviation: scoped to server-advertised tools (OpenClaw additionally narrows to app-declared tool names).
Metiq deviation: widget model context is delivered as active-run steering at the next model boundary, matching board.event delivery.

Per-sessionKey tabs/widgets store in internal/gateway/board; mints 2-minute HMAC view tickets (viewTicket/viewTicketTtlMs/viewGeneration/frameUrl) for renderable html widgets, served by the sandboxed frame host at /__metiq__/board/ on the gateway WS HTTP server.
Layout ops (tab_create/update/delete, tabs_reorder, widget_move/resize/remove) with revision counter and board.changed broadcast.

html, plugin, and mcp-app content sources (mcp-app pins the descriptor from an active MCP-App view; interactivity grant-gated via mcp.app.interact); canvas-doc rejected until the canvas-document surface lands. HTML grants frozen to approved bytes.
Revision- and instance-checked grant flow over pending capability declarations.
Re-mints an MCP-App view from the pinned mcp-app widget descriptor at an exact revision+instance; interactivity requires the granted mcp.app.interact capability, otherwise views mint read-only.
Legacy sessionKey+widget variant and ticket-authorized variant, 8KB payload cap and 5s dedupe; notices delivered as active-run steering.

Permission-engine audit-log listing backed by the WS-G engine's durable Auditor (internal/permissions) with time/type/tool/limit filters. Returns an honest available:false empty set when permissions are not configured.

Agent/session activity feed projected from the same WS-G permission audit log (decision/override/escalation events carry the acting agent + session). Honest available:false when permissions are not configured.
Accept seeds the suggested session via the shared sessions.create path; Metiq sessions.create does not auto-start a run, so acceptance completes when the session entry exists.
Static gateway-local environment plus sandbox-backed worker environments and configured extra.environments.profiles.
Status projection for gateway and managed sandbox environments.
Lists transcript-touched files and a bounded browser rooted at the persisted session workspace.
Reads bounded UTF-8 files through an os.Root-contained session workspace and returns a SHA-256 CAS token.
Atomically replaces an existing regular workspace file only when its SHA-256 expected hash matches.
Reveals only the persisted session workspace root using argument-vector host launching.
Workspace CAS-backed artifact store (internal/gateway/artifacts); artifacts are content-addressed blobs scoped by sessionKey/runId/taskId/agentId.
Workspace CAS-backed artifact lookup with scope filters.
Inline base64 download from the workspace CAS store (download.mode=bytes).
Self-update status backed by the real update.Checker. Read-only: reports the running version plus the last cached GitHub-release check; never forces a network fetch (that stays update.run).
Reads the persisted voicewake routing table (version/defaultTarget/routes).
Persists a validated routing table (max 32 routes, trigger normalization) and broadcasts voicewake.routing.changed.
Connection-scoped event-driven subscription to the advertised chat, session status, and tool lifecycle surface.
Removes the connection-scoped session event subscriptions without polling or timer-based completion.
Reads persisted per-session checkpoint metadata newest-first.
Reads one persisted checkpoint with gateway-v4 field names.
Creates a new session from a verified durable pre-compaction snapshot.
CAS-restores a verified durable checkpoint snapshot while preserving the prior branch.
Lists persisted transcript DAG heads with active-path metadata.
Atomically switches the active transcript DAG head.
Repoints the active path before a user entry while retaining the prior branch.
Creates an independent session from the active-path prefix before a user entry.
Applies a plugin-provided mutation to a session, namespaced under meta.plugins.<pluginId>, after validating the owning plugin against the merged plugin catalog.
GCs terminal/stale sessions (tombstoned past a grace period + optionally long-idle), deleting residual transcript entries. Complements age-based sessions.prune.
Removes persisted node trust and clears queued/in-flight runtime state.
Persists an operator label for a paired device with a 64-character bound.

Node-scoped plugin-surface refresh delivered to a paired+active node over the durable node pending-command queue (the node applies on pull). Deviation: unlike gateway-local plugin.surface.refresh (deferred, swarmstr-5p0v), the node owns its surface, so no local UI-surface registry is required.
Pushes an updated plugin-tool surface to a paired+active node over the durable node pending-command queue; the node applies on pull.
Pushes an updated skills surface to a paired+active node over the durable node pending-command queue; the node applies on pull.
Accepts bounded ordered chunks, deduplicates and buffers gaps, and pushes contiguous progress over WS subscriptions.
Returns one persisted cron job by id or jobId.
Returns the persisted scratch document, monotonic current revision, and byte limit.
Persists string or null scratch content with optional compare-and-set revision semantics.

Honest UNAVAILABLE (unregistered → status missing). swarmstr has no durable per-message action runtime (no mutable chat-message store with react/edit/delete/retry); the conversations registry tracks turns, not message mutations. The implement-locked `message` triage prefix cannot express a per-method accepted-deviation, so the method is left unregistered per the gateway.suspend precedent. Follow-up: swarmstr-ko2f (human_input_required product decision).
Reuses channel send internals; media output markers dispatch via the shared outbound media helper. Operation-id dedupe is process-local.
Send plus in-process reply correlation on the extension inbound path; correlationPersisted=false (no durable delivery store yet).
Cancels the process-local pending turn waiter.
Operator abort remains unconditional. Busy queue-mode interrupt is tool-aware: it aborts only when active tools are interruptible and otherwise defers newest input as urgent active-run steering.
Lists durable pending DM sender requests for configured pairing-policy accounts.
Durably adds the observed sender to the account allowlist before removing its pending request.
Dismisses a durable pending DM sender request for the owning account.
Metiq deviation: sessionKey is required (no main-session default); mcpConfig references the admin MCP loopback runtime and the env token is METIQ_MCP_TOKEN.
Single-owner take-over with ring-buffer replay; previous owner receives terminal.exit reason=detached. Metiq has no agent-owned shared-viewer sessions.

Honest UNAVAILABLE (accepted-deviation). swarmstr wires no GitHub/git-forge integration, so PR/branch preview data cannot be produced without a fabricated stub. Left unimplemented consistent with the openclaw-branded-control-ui deviation. Follow-up: swarmstr-uhup.

Daemon identity/health snapshot backed by the build-info globals (version/commit from ldflags), the Go runtime, and live subsystem presence. Reports version, commit, platform (os/arch/go/cpu), pid, uptime, and capability flags (mcp/permissions/channels/node/tasks/sessions/worktrees).
Workspace-scoped agent listing over the durable agent-docs surface (DocsRepository.ListAgents), optionally filtered to one workspace; tombstoned agents excluded.
Single workspace agent detail from the durable agent-docs surface (DocsRepository.GetAgent).
Compat alias (openclaw naming) for talk.speak: identical persona/voice-alias-aware synthesis through the live tts manager. Metiq also exposes raw synthesis as tts.convert.
Merged catalog: config plugins.installs/entries unioned with live GojaPluginManager manifests (enabled/loaded/source/tools).
Substring ranking over the merged local plugin catalog.
Toggles plugins.entries.<id>.enabled via the runtime config mutation commit path.
Idempotent GojaPluginManager reload against current config, returning the refreshed listing.

Honest UNAVAILABLE (accepted-deviation). No git-forge integration exists to associate PRs with a session. Left unimplemented consistent with the openclaw-branded-control-ui deviation. Follow-up: swarmstr-uhup.
Diffs two durable session snapshots (compaction checkpoints) on the session DAG, reporting field-level deltas plus token/timestamp deltas.

Honest UNAVAILABLE (accepted deviation, stays missing). Verifies OpenClaw onboarding completion; there is no OpenClaw setup to verify for a nostr-native daemon. Left unregistered. Product follow-up: swarmstr-nuqy.
Provisions a docker-sandbox environment from a configured profile with idempotencyKey dedupe; fails closed when docker is unavailable.
Retires a managed sandbox environment; idempotent on already-destroyed ids.
Projects the durable local SessionStore into the OpenClaw catalog host shape with bounded cursor pagination.
Reads the authoritative persisted transcript for a local catalog session with bounded cursor pagination.
Metiq deviation: the file is staged into the PTY session's working directory under os.Root containment instead of a host temp dir.
Idempotently restores a durable archived local session and returns its existing session key.
Persists archive state without deleting transcript or workspace data and rejects active runs.
Returns durable exec, plugin, or system-owned approval records through one projection.
Applies first-answer resolution to durable exec, plugin, or system-owned approvals.
Bounded deterministic case-insensitive transcript search over persisted user and assistant messages.

Bounded reachability probe of a provider's configured endpoint (config base_url or provider default); reports reachable/status/latency. The endpoint is derived from operator config, never request params.
Computes a migration/maintenance plan over the versioned SQLite store (schema_version vs sqliteSchemaVersion, FTS drift, embedding reindex backlog, legacy chunks).
Applies the plan: idempotent schema migration + FTS rebuild + legacy backfill; reports before/after.

Executes a UI-originated named command by dispatching the gateway method the embedded Web UI maps that slash command to (e.g. /status→status, /agents→agents.list, /compact→memory.compact). OperatorAdmin.
Resolved (closed) records from the durable exec/unified approval ledger — the historical counterpart of approval.list (which defaults to pending), newest-resolved first.

Re-scans + re-aggregates the plugin UI-surface registry (all-plugins scope also reloads the plugin manager; single-plugin scope re-aggregates) and emits the plugin.surface.changed push event. OperatorAdmin. Delivered by swarmstr-qmxu.
Process-local conversation registry: observed extension-channel senders plus joined NIP-29 group channels.
Provider-contract discussion surface; absent provider reports state none, provider failures stay transient errors.
Provider-contract discussion open behind the collaboration mutation matrix with sessions.changed projection.
Ticket-authorized prompt confirmation check; confirmationRequired unless the 'prompt' tool is granted.

Ticket-authorized granted data bindings over the core allowlist (sessions.list, usage.status, usage.cost, cron.list, cron.status, agents.list, health); plugin dashboard bindings deferred with the plugin dashboard registry.
Ticket-authorized cron.trigger:<jobId> actions dispatching cron.run; plugin dashboard action verbs deferred with the plugin dashboard registry.
Bounded transcript-digest observer ask over the per-session runtime with busy/global/per-connection admission limits.
Connection-scoped observer visibility declaration tracked by the session coordinator.
Persisted sharing-doc visibility with owner/admin authorization and session.sharing event projection.
Owner/admin-scoped membership aggregate with identity catalog and allowed visibilities.
Idempotent persisted membership grant with session.sharing member-added projection.
Idempotent persisted membership revocation with session.sharing member-removed projection.
Persisted pending suggestion on suggest-visibility sessions with identified author and session.suggestion projection.
Role-filtered persisted suggestion listing (viewers see own rows; managers see pending plus own history).
Owner/admin send/queue/edit/dismiss resolution with claimed dispatch through sessions.send and resolved-event projection.
Connection-scoped typing with multi-connection identity accounting, throttle, TTL expiry, and visibility-filtered session.typing events.
